action: Trace cargo-pod producer, renderer identity and animated ownership before selecting edits.
observation: Cargo jettison spawns payloadType jettisoned_cargo; partsLibrary maps it to the standard place pod. Yard dressing and named derelict POIs also use it. Eight ANI-11 door/lock/retainer groups and ANI-24 drift constrain geometry changes.
decision: Preserve canonical identity, sockets, motion pivots and separate place/payload scale consumers. Do not substitute the distinct pod_cargo_container asset.
next: Inspect actual package and live-camera readability.
performance: Consumer tracing only; encounter frequency and frame time not measured.

action: Measure current source, release and compiled package geometry and resource layout.
observation: Source and release have 12604/5036/2258 triangles and 20 primitives at LOD0/1/2. Package is 547940 bytes with six textures; its three extra untagged lamp primitives account for 36 triangles, so per-LOD name filtering alone undercounts each level by 12. Shared immutable resources are compiled once by renderPackageLoader.
decision: Retain motion-separated draws and existing shared texture system. Treat primitive counts as asset cost, not FPS or confirmed batching.
next: Judge all three LODs in renderer before removing detail.
performance: Static byte/geometry census only; no runtime performance conclusion.

action: Build a hollow front mouth to replace the solid box revealed by the animated doors.
observation: Three center-mouth Blender rays at z -0.5/0/0.5 hit baseline Cavity 0.14m behind the door plane. The scratch shell moves the rear bulkhead to 0.98m depth while keeping all eight motion groups. Initial LOD0 geometry rises from 12604 to 13920 triangles.
decision: Keep as an unapproved scratch candidate; real depth is established but visual benefit and low-LOD integrity need renderer comparison.
next: Reduce avoidable new chamfer cost without flattening the mouth.
performance: Initial candidate adds 1316 LOD0 triangles; not accepted as a performance improvement.

action: Reduce tessellation on the new cavity and split mouth rib while preserving the hollow shell.
observation: One-segment chamfers limited to Cavity and Rib8 parts reduce candidate LOD0 from 13920 to 12624 triangles, only 20 above original. All three mouth rays still reach the 0.98m rear bulkhead and all eight motion groups remain.
decision: Prefer compact candidate for the pending visual comparison; do not change other authored bevels or promote before images.
next: Compare source-open, compact-open and closed poses under live lighting, including LOD1/2.
performance: 1296 triangles removed from first candidate; no frame-time measurement and no shipped change.

next: Inspect queued actual-package views and matched candidate poses; verify low-LOD shell appearance.
decision: Static contract preservation passes. Keep candidate in scratch until live-camera comparison and ordinary route establish appearance and motion behavior.
action: Verify hollow-mouth candidate preserves collision, sockets and all animated door/drift data.
observation: Both socket transforms and extras match exactly; collision bounds and 26 directional supports have zero delta. All 42 moving meshes across LOD0/1/2 retain exact geometry and local transforms. Full baked motion bank matches canonical excluding expected source hash: eight bindings and breach, seal, pod_drift_wobble clips with all samples and events unchanged.
performance: No frame-time conclusion. Candidate LOD0 remains 12624 triangles, +20 versus source.

observation: Actual producer plus selector calls for six inert/volatile commodities all lack authoredPayloadAssetId, fail explicit authored admission and select pods/pod_cargo_container.glb. The standard-pod conditional selector is bypassed. Named fx/dressing POIs and selected everyday station-yard placements have connected standard-pod place routes, but ordinary visibility remains unobserved.
action: Test producer/admission routing and correct the initial standard-pod jettison assumption.
performance: Six texture images and full KTX2 mip chains; no actionable map duplication remains in release. No FPS claim.
decision: Correct initial journal entry 1 and facts; do not treat ordinary jettison as this model acceptance route or silently rewire cargo variants. Retain existing shared panel/machinery maps and charcoal interior material after slot/image review.
next: Observe named standard-pod place route and queued images; assess any generic cargo variant issue separately with its owner.
Inspect queued source-open and compact-open comparison at all three LODs.
observation: Teal roof and hazard bands remain distinct; grapple is attached; end-door locking bars read clearly against the dark doors. Warm light makes the near sidewall markedly lighter than the teal roof, without a demonstrated map mismatch. All four captures have actual target draws. The raw-file chase view is small and does not include ordinary world radius fitting.
action: Inspect current standard-pod LOD0 through live renderer at place, top, side and chase views.
performance: Live target draw report retained; isolated draw count is not a frame-time benchmark.
decision: Retain existing exterior palette and shared surfaces. Do not lighten all charcoal materials from the dark door view alone; judge the hollow-mouth candidate in matched open views. No ordinary-route acceptance or frame-time claim.

action: Compare correctly posed source and compact hollow-mouth exports from end and oblique at LOD0/1/2 through current renderer.
observation: Candidate exposes threshold floor and inner right wall where source inner face sits nearly flush. Doors open visibly; lock groups remain unchanged. Twelve corrected views each submit20 draws, errors empty. LOD2 broad highlights are stronger in both source and candidate, so this is not a candidate-only regression.
decision: Retain scratch hollow-mouth candidate for integration review; do not publish from isolated posed views. No extra same-material static merge is available: six distinct static materials and fourteen independently animated submissions.
performance: Same20 target submissions; no frame-time claim.
next: Review candidate integration and ordinary-route motion/LOD presentation before publication; requested twenty substantive iterations remain incomplete.
